column1: # Ondra, the Tideglass Queen, in Tolbi.

column3:
You went down to the pier
for a stranger's child.
The tide noticed.{page_break}Who wakes the Queen of
the Deep?{end_wait}
You look like Mia... Who\nare you?{end_wait}

I am Ondra. Mia descends
from my tide, so we share
a face.{page_break}When the waking took my
kingdom, I drowned it
myself. Show me your mercy.{end_wait}
I didn't come to fight you,\nbut I won't walk away.{end_wait}
